def _package_current_manifest(repo, tracked):
    owner = _package_owned_owner()
    authority = _package_owned_authority()
    owner.readmit_current_all376(repo, authority)
    data, _ = stable_bytes(repo / authority["current_manifest"]["path"])
    require(len(data) == authority["current_manifest"]["bytes"]
            and sha256(data) == authority["current_manifest"]["sha256"], "fixed package current manifest differs")
    current = strict_json(data)
    require(current["reviewed_source_head"] == authority["current_checkpoint"]["head"]
            and current["source_only_tree"] == authority["current_checkpoint"]["tree"], "fixed current checkpoint differs")
    rows = {row["path"]: row for row in current["files"]}
    require(len(rows) == len(current["files"]) == 376, "current-all376 membership differs")
    require(rows["src/main.rs"] == authority["current_main"], "current main commitment differs")
    for name, expected in rows.items():
        require(name in tracked and tracked[name]["type"] == "blob"
                and tracked[name]["git_mode"] in ("100644", "100755"), "current source is not a tracked regular blob")
        body, mode = stable_bytes(repo / relative_member(name))
        require(len(body) == expected["bytes"] and sha256(body) == expected["sha256"], "fixed current source body differs: " + name)
        require(hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(body)).encode() + b"\0" + body).hexdigest()
                == tracked[name]["git_blob"], "current source blob differs")
        require(bool(mode & 0o111) == (tracked[name]["git_mode"] == "100755"), "current source mode differs")
    controllers = owner.authenticated_controller_members(repo, "owned-array")
    require(type(controllers) is tuple and controllers and len(controllers) == len(set(controllers)),
            "complete original-owner controller closure is required")
    owner.readmit_current_all376(repo, authority)
    return current, controllers


def _package_capture_association(repo, tracked, rows):
    current, controllers = _package_current_manifest(repo, tracked)
    authority = _package_owned_authority()
    require(all(name in rows for name in controllers), "current controller capture is incomplete")
    require(all(rows[item["path"]]["bytes"] == item["bytes"]
                and rows[item["path"]]["sha256"] == item["sha256"] for item in current["files"]),
            "captured current-all376 bodies differ")
    return _package_owned_owner().capture_source_association(
        repo, authority=authority, current_members=current["files"],
        controller_members={name: rows[name] for name in controllers}, captured_members=rows)


def _package_replay_source(root, profile, checkout, frozen_binding, schema):

            "fixed independent profile differs")
    original_data, _ = stable_bytes(root / "evidence/original-source.json")
    originals = strict_json(original_data)
    original_map = {row["path"]: row for row in originals}
    require(len(original_map) == len(originals), "duplicate original-source member")
    archived = {}
    with stable_file(root / "evidence/source.tar") as (stream, before):
        require(sha256(stream.read()) == frozen_binding["archive_sha256"], "actual replay archive differs")
        stream.seek(0)
        with tarfile.open(fileobj=stream, mode="r:") as archive:
            seen = set()
            for member in archive:
                name = str(relative_member(member.name.rstrip("/")))
                require(name not in seen and (member.isfile() or member.isdir()), "unsafe replay archive member")
                seen.add(name)
                if member.isdir():
                    continue
                data = archive.extractfile(member).read()
                archived[name] = {"path": name, "bytes": len(data), "sha256": sha256(data),
                                  "executable": bool(member.mode & 0o111),
                                  "mode": "100755" if member.mode & 0o111 else "100644",
                                  "git_blob": hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(data)).encode() + b"\0" + data).hexdigest()}
        require(archived == original_map, "actual archive member/blob map differs from original-source")
    require(sha256(original_data) == frozen_binding["original_manifest_sha256"], "original-source body differs")
    current_manifest, _ = stable_bytes(root / "source" / authority["current_manifest"]["path"])

    current = strict_json(current_manifest)
    for row in current["files"] + [authority["current_manifest"]]:
        require(row["path"] in archived and all(archived[row["path"]][key] == row[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256")),
                "archive omitted or substituted fixed current source: " + row["path"])
    native = "src/frontend/oir/owned/native_tests.rs"
    module = "src/frontend/oir/owned/unit2d_independent.rs"
    prepared = schema.tree_manifest(root / "source")
    prepared_map = {row["path"]: row for row in prepared}
    require(prepared == frozen_binding["prepared"] and set(prepared_map) == set(original_map) | {module}
            and module not in original_map, "unexpected prepared-source member changes")
    for name, row in original_map.items():
        if name != native:
            require(prepared_map[name] == {key: row[key] for key in ("path", "bytes", "sha256", "executable")},
                    "unexpected prepared-source body changes: " + name)
    frozen = (root / "inputs/sources/reviewer-array-native-v3.rs").read_bytes()
    reviewer = schema.projected_loan_reviewer(schema.borrowed_slot_reviewer(schema.public_array_reviewer(frozen)))
    reviewer = schema.pre_u8_oracle_bytes(schema.stdin_carrier_bytes("reviewer", schema.enum_carrier_bytes("reviewer", reviewer)))
    require((root / "source" / module).read_bytes() == reviewer, "prepared replay reviewer differs")
    appendix = b"\n\n// Ephemeral independent Unit2D replay controls.\n"
    for name in schema.CONTROL_FILES:
        control = (root / "inputs/sources" / name).read_bytes()
        if name == "old-ir-export-v1.rs":
            control = schema.old_ir_resource_exporter(control)
        control = schema.stdin_carrier_bytes(name, schema.enum_carrier_bytes(name, control))
        appendix += control + b"\n"
    appendix += b'\n#[cfg(test)]\n#[path = "unit2d_independent.rs"]\nmod unit2d_independent;\n'
    require(sha256(appendix) == frozen_binding["appendix_sha256"], "frozen appendix differs")
    content_id, marker = frozen_binding["content_id"], frozen_binding["marker"]
    marker_source = ('\n#[test]\nfn ' + marker + '() {\n'
        '    assert_eq!(std::env::var("OXID_UNIT2D_REPLAY_BINDING").unwrap(), "' + content_id + '");\n'
        '    assert_eq!(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"), ' + json.dumps(str(root / "source"), ensure_ascii=False) + ');\n'
        '    eprintln!("OXID_UNIT2D_SOURCE_BINDING=' + content_id + '");\n}\n').encode()
    actual_native = (root / "source" / native).read_bytes()
    prefix = actual_native[:original_map[native]["bytes"]]
    require(sha256(prefix) == original_map[native]["sha256"]
            and actual_native == prefix + appendix + marker_source, "native overlay is not the exact frozen append")
    return owner.verify_replay_source_image(root, profile=profile, checkout=checkout, authority=authority,
        archive_members=archived, original_source=originals, prepared_source=prepared,
        exact_native_append=appendix + marker_source, exact_added_module=reviewer,
